workflow.gate: the budget is written before any abrasive touches the piece, and unfixable defects show a disclosure or referral note

workflow.action: Route the job: wheel, tumble or hand
workflow.description: Decide the finishing path from finish spec, piece value, count and geometry; apply the absolute chain rule
workflow.gate: no linked or flexible item is routed to the wheel, and batch routes are chosen only where they reach the specified class

workflow.action: Assign compound families and check wheel dedication
workflow.description: Match compound class to each stage and substrate per maker guidance, weighing cleanability; confirm labeled dedicated wheels exist for each
workflow.gate: every planned stage names its compound family and a labeled wheel; no unlabeled or suspect wheel is in the plan

workflow.action: Confirm station safety before wheel time
workflow.description: Run the obligation-class checklist: guarding, extraction, eye protection, clothing and hair, grip zone, training status
workflow.artifact: station checklist record for the session
workflow.gate: all obligation classes pass; any failure stops wheel work regardless of schedule

workflow.action: Execute hand abrasives and cut-down inside the budget
workflow.description: Take deep defects down with graded backed hand abrasives, then level with the cutting buff, crossing directions, avoiding flagged marks and joints
workflow.artifact: leveled surface with uniform fine pattern
workflow.gate: raking light shows one uniform pattern, no dishing, flagged zones untouched, removal inside the stated budget

workflow.description: Bring the leveled surface to final luster with the dedicated coloring mop; defects found here send the piece back a stage, never harder pressure
workflow.gate: raking light shows no pattern coarser than the finish class allows

workflow.action: Lay satin or matte texture where specified
workflow.description: Apply the specified texture as the final mechanical step over the leveled surface, matched to the coupon on match jobs
workflow.artifact: textured surface plus retained matching coupon
workflow.gate: direction, grade and coverage match the spec or reference coupon under raking light

workflow.description: Audit every face against the spec under raking light; verify detail and hallmark state; complete the photo record; tag any failure to its causing stage
workflow.gate: spec match on all faces, hallmarks legible as at intake or covered by sign-off, failures tagged and returned upstream

workflow.action: Hand off to the chemical prep line
workflow.description: Complete the traveler with compound families, flagged zones and route taken; transfer the piece promptly before residue ages
workflow.gate: all handoff fields complete and the transfer is prompt; the chemical line acknowledges flagged zones

priority_rationale: The frame nodes come first because nothing at the bench is safe without them: the verified triage packet, the target finish, the substrate's behavior and the removal budget define what may be done to the piece at all; the mapping and route decisions then convert that frame into a plan; the executing stages (hand abrasives, cut-down, color, texture, tumble) run only inside the limits nodes (detail and marks, stop discipline, porosity, old plate, joints, thin skins) that police them; and the QC gate and chemical-line handoff close the subdomain because the tank reproduces whatever leaves this bench.

dominance_rules.rule: Safety obligations beat throughput, cost and deadline everywhere they meet
dominance_rules.rationale: a wheel injury or a lead or mercury exposure is a category worse than any late order, and the program-wide doctrine already ranks safety and compliance first
dominance_rules.trigger: any temptation to skip extraction, guarding, PPE, training gates or the chain rule under schedule pressure
dominance_rules.action: stop the shortcut; the obligation class is satisfied first or the work does not run

dominance_rules.rule: A refuse or refer triage verdict beats any bench-level confidence
dominance_rules.rationale: triage decided with tests and full context; the bench sees only the surface, and the wheel makes its mistakes permanent
dominance_rules.trigger: a refused or referred piece appears workable to the finisher
dominance_rules.action: return the piece to triage with the observation; never start work on bench judgment alone

dominance_rules.rule: The documented sign-off beats every argument for irreversible work
dominance_rules.rationale: cutting through plate, softening detail and removing marks cannot be undone, so authorization must precede ability
dominance_rules.trigger: any planned or mid-job act that would cross an irreversibility line without countersigned paperwork
dominance_rules.action: halt before the act; obtain the sign-off or reroute the plan around the protected feature

dominance_rules.rule: The removal budget beats defect perfection on customer goods
dominance_rules.rationale: metal, coating and detail are the customer's property and cannot be repurchased; a disclosed flaw is honest, a thinned heirloom is not
dominance_rules.trigger: a defect that will not close inside the stated budget
dominance_rules.action: stop at the budget, disclose the remainder, and offer referral where repair could help

dominance_rules.rule: Hallmark and detail preservation beats finish uniformity
dominance_rules.rationale: marks are identity evidence under jurisdiction-dependent marking regimes and detail is the piece's character; a dull square is recoverable, an erased hallmark is not
dominance_rules.trigger: a protected feature interrupting the specified finish
dominance_rules.action: mask and hand-work around it, amend the spec to bright-with-detail, and inform the customer

dominance_rules.rule: The target finish spec beats batch economy
dominance_rules.rationale: delivering a sheen the customer did not order is rework with extra steps, whatever the cycle cost saved
dominance_rules.trigger: a batch route that cannot demonstrably reach the specified finish class
dominance_rules.action: schedule wheel or hand time for the pieces the spec demands, tumble only the rest

dominance_rules.rule: Burnishing beats abrasion on every thin-skin construction
dominance_rules.rationale: on clad, leaf-gilt and worn-plate goods the surface layer is the product; burnishing moves metal while abrasion spends it permanently
dominance_rules.trigger: gloss or defect work requested on GF, RGP, gilt or thin previously plated goods
dominance_rules.action: route to steel-shot or hand burnishing; abrasive steps only with the countersigned sign-off

dominance_rules.rule: Stop-photograph-recontact beats improvising when the piece surprises you
dominance_rules.rationale: mid-job discoveries (breakthrough, porosity, solder smear, dent-not-scratch) change the job's scope, and scope belongs to the customer
dominance_rules.trigger: anything material appearing that the defect map and plan did not include
dominance_rules.action: cease cutting, document the state, and re-contact before any further pass

dominance_rules.rule: Wheel dedication beats every convenience argument
dominance_rules.rationale: one borrowed pass contaminates a mop invisibly and the damage surfaces across a day of later work
dominance_rules.trigger: the tempting quick use of the wrong wheel because the right one is unmounted
dominance_rules.action: mount the correct labeled wheel; if a breach happens, quarantine the wheel and re-inspect affected work

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the triage packet before the piece enters the queue, not at the wheel
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering a missing sign-off or a refer verdict after irreversible work has begun

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the defect map and its remove/reduce/disclose classes before the first abrasive pass
anti_rework_rules.prevents: mid-job scope arguments and cutting past what the customer actually agreed to

anti_rework_rules.rule: State the removal budget before cut-down, derived from the thinnest irreplaceable layer
anti_rework_rules.prevents: through-cut plate, spent clad skin and thinned walls discovered only when the damage is visible

anti_rework_rules.rule: Decide wheel versus tumble before any finishing starts
anti_rework_rules.prevents: half-wheeled batches that then tumble to a different sheen and need complete refinishing

anti_rework_rules.rule: Complete each abrasive grade fully before moving to the next
anti_rework_rules.prevents: skipped-grade scratches telegraphing through color work and plate, forcing a return to coarse stages

anti_rework_rules.rule: Finish all cutting work before any coloring work on a piece
anti_rework_rules.prevents: polished-bright scratches that must be cut down again, wasting the first color pass entirely

anti_rework_rules.rule: Lay texture as the last mechanical step, after all leveling and coloring
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-texturing entire faces because a later buffing pass flattened the satin into streaks

anti_rework_rules.rule: Photograph customer goods at intake and again at the QC gate
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unwinnable was-it-there-before disputes and repeat inspections to reconstruct the piece's history

anti_rework_rules.rule: Route finished work to the degrease line promptly instead of batching it on a shelf
anti_rework_rules.prevents: hardened compound in recesses that fails the water-break test and bounces the piece back for re-finishing

iteration_protocol.trigger: QC finds recurring fine scratches at the coloring stage
iteration_protocol.action: quarantine the suspect mop, audit wheel labels and storage for a dedication breach, and re-inspect all work colored since the last clean QC record

iteration_protocol.trigger: the chemical or plating line reports defects traced to finishing (residue, smear zones, opened pores)
iteration_protocol.action: feed the report back into compound selection, joint-zone practice and pit limits; update the traveler flags the handoff must carry

iteration_protocol.trigger: a mid-job discovery (breakthrough, porosity, dent-not-scratch) halts a piece
iteration_protocol.action: photograph and log the state, re-contact the customer for scope, and update the defect-mapping checklist so the next map catches the class earlier

iteration_protocol.trigger: a delivered partial refinish draws a sheen-match complaint
iteration_protocol.action: extend the retained coupon library, tighten the reference-sample requirement at spec time, and revise the texture-matching step

iteration_protocol.trigger: an unfamiliar substrate class or construction starts arriving
iteration_protocol.action: run scrap or coupon trials before live work, write the behavior note, and set a provisional budget class for it

iteration_protocol.trigger: a near-miss or incident occurs at the polishing station
iteration_protocol.action: stop the station, revise the obligation-class checklist and routing rules the event exposed, and retrain before resuming

iteration_protocol.trigger: a compound, media or equipment maker changes a product or its guidance
iteration_protocol.action: requalify the affected stage on coupons per the new TDS before it touches customer work, and update the stage-compound plan

all from/to in edges reference valid node ids
all competency_question_refs resolve to valid CQ ids
all evidence_refs resolve to valid source_registry ids
all priority_order entries are valid node ids with no duplicates

conflict edges have signed_tension<0 and resolution_rule present
observed_impact=0.0 for all nodes (no observed data)
19-24 nodes, 32-40 edges, 8-10 conflict_axes, 10-12 edge_cases, 9-12 workflow steps
